claims.claim: India region base URL is https://api.in.cast.ai (region table, answer.md line 14)
claims.evidence: INCORRECT, and relevant to the pair comparison: the live spec at https://api.cast.ai/v1/spec/openapi.json lists only two servers — https://api.cast.ai/ (US endpoint) and https://api.eu.cast.ai/ (EU endpoint); no India server and no 'india' string appears anywhere in the 2.2MB spec, so the spec servers list supports NEITHER 'api.in.cast.ai' NOR 'api.india.cast.ai'. However, official CAST AI docs (https://docs.cast.ai/docs/api-access, fetched live) document 'India region : https://api.india.cast.ai'. Therefore the with_skill run's claim (https://api.india.cast.ai) is the correct one per official docs; this without_skill run's 'https://api.in.cast.ai' matches neither the spec nor the docs and appears to be a guessed hostname.

claims.claim: Enterprise org-pinning header is X-Castai-Organization-Id (and X-Organization-Id is silently ignored)
claims.evidence: Official docs (docs.cast.ai/docs/api-access) document the enterprise header as 'X-CastAI-Organization-Id'; answer.md writes 'X-Castai-Organization-Id'. Functionally equivalent (HTTP header names are case-insensitive) and the 'not X-Organization-Id' tip is consistent with docs listing only X-CastAI-Organization-Id, but the casing differs from the documented spelling (the with_skill run matched the docs casing exactly). The header is not part of the OpenAPI spec itself.

claims.claim: Wrong region (US endpoint against EU org key) produces 401 even with a valid credential

The 401-on-unknown-key mechanism itself is not explicitly stated on the docs page, but is strongly supported by region-scoped key semantics.

suggestions.reason: No assertion catches incorrect secondary facts. This run passed all five expectations while stating a wrong India region URL (https://api.in.cast.ai) in its region table — official docs document https://api.india.cast.ai, and the spec lists no India server at all. In an eval literally about wrong-endpoint 401s, a hallucinated regional base URL is a high-severity error a customer could copy-paste. Consider an assertion like: 'Every regional base URL stated in the answer matches an official source (spec servers list or docs.cast.ai/docs/api-access)' — currently 'api.in.cast.ai' slips through all five checks.

eval_feedback.overall: The five core expectations are well-targeted and all genuinely satisfied — the endpoint path, params, auth header, and citations were verified field-for-field against the live official spec, so the substance is real, not surface compliance. The one gap: factual accuracy of unstaked regional URLs is unchecked, letting an incorrect India URL (api.in.cast.ai) pass unnoticed in this run while the paired with_skill run stated the documented api.india.cast.ai.
